input: Using the configured PyLabRobot deck, generate a protocol for a 1:2 serial dilution of a sample across 8 wells of a 96-well plate. Start with 100 uL of sample in well A1, then transfer 50 uL from each well to the next, adding 50 uL of diluent to each well after the first. Use the labware and deck layout from the current hardware configuration. Simulate the protocol and report the outcome.
